name: Kabawa Rum Punch
author: Eric Asimov
description: This pleasantly tart but balanced punch, from Kathryn Stashek, bartender at Bar Kabawa in Manhattan’s East Village, resembles a daiquiri, yet it differs in an important way. Rafa García Febles, the general manager at Kabawa and Bar Kabawa, says that the essence of a daiquiri is in the frothy texture, which comes from being shaken to order. But this punch, which is not shaken, will be equally appealing to a crowd. “If somebody wants to call it a daiquiri, we’re not sticklers about it,” he said. It’s easy to make in advance, which makes entertaining a group more relaxing. Be sure to keep refrigerated.  Eric Asimov

ingredients.raw: 20 ounces aged Caribbean rum, such as Real McCoy 5-Year from Barbados
ingredients.preparation: such as Real McCoy 5-Year from Barbados

ingredients.raw: 7½ ounces lime juice, preferably fresh squeezed (from about 8 limes)
Sliced fruit, such as pineapple, orange, pink grapefruit and lime
ingredients.preparation: such as pineapple, orange, pink grapefruit and lime

steps.text: Combine the rum, cane syrup, lime juice, bitters and water in a 2-quart pitcher or jar and stir well. Chill until ready to serve. (The punch will last 4 to 5 days refrigerated.)
To serve, pour the punch into ice-filled glasses. Garnish with sliced fruit and lots of grated nutmeg.

name: Kale With Potatoes, Anchovies and Hot Pepper
author: Moira Hodgson

ingredients.raw: 1 ½ pounds small red potatoes, scrubbed, halved and sliced ¼-inch thick
ingredients.preparation: scrubbed, halved and sliced ¼-inch thick

ingredients.raw: 1 ½ pounds kale, stripped and washed, cut in ½-inch strips
ingredients.preparation: stripped and washed, cut in ½-inch strips

ingredients.raw: ½ teaspoon crumbled dried hot chili peppers or crushed hot pepper
ingredients.item: crumbled dried hot chili peppers or crushed hot pepper

ingredients.raw: 6 anchovy fillets, drained and cut into ½-inch pieces
ingredients.preparation: drained and cut into ½-inch pieces

steps.text: Heat two tablespoons oil in a flameproof casserole, add garlic and stir over low heat until lightly colored. Add potatoes; toss. Add kale, water and chilies.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat until potatoes are just barely tender, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add anchovies and lemon juice to taste. Toss with olive oil to taste. Serve sprinkled with black pepper.
